confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer/coffee anchors rest on crowdsourced or aggregator Atlanta data from 2026 (Numbeo, Expatistan, Cities Insider, MyLifeElsewhere), so they are approximate. Cocktail is a blend of sources that disagree (about $11 to $17). Wine by the glass has no reliable citywide figure; the anchor is a bounded estimate based on one venue's house-wine range and the US restaurant wine-to-beer relationship, so it is low confidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Atlanta, not from inspected live listings. The FX value comes from a search result that attributes an 18 Nov 2026 RBA 4.00 pm rate of 0.6720 to the RBA overview page; I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed: food and drink anchors use Atlanta-specific 2026 price data, with a bounded estimate for wine by the glass. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a large US metro with a mid-range hotel market.
